0022600101.text: The Grizzlies (1-0, W1) visit the Warriors (0-1, L1) for the second game of Memphis's season, with Memphis sitting 2nd in the Southwest and 6th in the West and Golden State 3rd in the Pacific and 13th in the West. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Grizzlies lost all three games to Golden State in 2025-26, most recently 133-112 in Memphis on February 25, 2026. For Memphis, Cedric Coward (wrist sprain) and Isaiah Stewart (ankle sprain) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, while Golden State is without Charles Bassey (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery).
